name: Paketo

_root: capsule - rounded rect with a solid header stripe
_silhouette: the capsule torn into three shards along an 18px line, 2px gaps, zigzag tear edges, one eye on the lead shard.

name: Rafagón
_root: capsule - rounded rect with a solid header stripe
_silhouette: eleven 4x3 shards spiralling out of a filled 6px lozenge core, 22px across.
_frame2: the spiral advances one slot: the outermost shard leaves the frame and a new one appears at the core.

name: Bippo

name: Estátic
_root: mast - thin vertical pole, background visible on both sides at every height
_silhouette: 3px pole 16px tall, three crossbars of increasing width, a 5px dish tilted left.

_root: mast - thin vertical pole, background visible on both sides at every height
_silhouette: three fused poles 20px tall, six crossbars, every dish bent downward, a solid 4px block at the base.
_frame2: each dish swings 1px out of phase, so the whole mast visibly shivers.

name: Lagui

name: Jitera
_root: solid body trailed by DETACHED echo dots (the only body drawn with a gap)
_silhouette: 9px body split by a 2px horizontal jitter offset, five echo dots of alternating size.
_frame2: the two body halves swap which way the jitter offset points.

name: Timaut
_root: solid body trailed by DETACHED echo dots (the only body drawn with a gap)
_silhouette: 10px body with a hollow centre, seven echoes growing into 3px blocks, the last touching the frame edge.
_frame2: the whole trail slides one slot forward and the body's hollow closes for one frame.

name: Pixio
_root: chunky discrete blocks dissolving along a diagonal

name: Artefax
_root: chunky discrete blocks dissolving along a diagonal
_silhouette: 14x14 of nine blocks, three of them displaced 3px along the diagonal.
_frame2: the three displaced blocks jump to the opposite diagonal.

name: Burnix
_root: chunky discrete blocks dissolving along a diagonal
_silhouette: 20x20 with the diagonal band burnt through to nothing, remaining blocks tapering to single pixels top-right.
_frame2: the burn band steps one block down-left: it eats a new block and gives the old one back.

name: Spamito
_root: chain of linked flats (never one body)
_silhouette: three 6x4 flats linked by 2px joins in a short arc, one flat carrying two dot eyes.

name: Kadenax
_root: chain of linked flats (never one body)

name: Blaklix
_root: chain of linked flats (never one body)
_silhouette: fourteen flats closed into a ring around a solid 8px core, four of them fused into a bar.
_frame2: the ring rotates one link and the core's edge pixels invert.

name: Buggo
_root: legged low oval (the only many-legged body)

_frame2: alternate leg pairs lift: a step.

name: Exploid
_root: legged low oval (the only many-legged body)

_frame2: the pincer opens and closes.

name: Rootkar
_root: legged low oval (the only many-legged body)
_silhouette: 16x10 body, eight long legs reaching the frame edge, a four-spike crown.
_frame2: the body drops 1px while the legs splay: a lunge.

name: Wormi
_root: serpentine S-curve (never legs)
_silhouette: three-segment S, 4px thick, blunt head, one eye.
_frame2: the S phase-shifts one segment: a crawl.

name: Parasix
flavor_es: Vive de lo que tú tienes.
_root: serpentine S-curve (never legs)
_silhouette: five-segment S, six hook barbs on the outer curves, wider head.
_frame2: the barbs retract flush and pop back out.

name: Plagón
_root: serpentine S-curve (never legs)
_silhouette: eight-segment coil filling the frame, split tail, round maw of five teeth.
_frame2: the coil tightens 1px and the maw opens.

name: Karnada
_root: open hook - straight shank, one bend, one barb
_silhouette: 12px shank with a single bend and a 2px barb, a 4px bait blob hanging off the barb, one eye on the blob.
_frame2: the bait blob swings 1px on the barb.

name: Klonix
_root: open hook - straight shank, one bend, one barb
_silhouette: two parallel hooks sharing one shank, four barbs, the bait grown into a 6px mask with two eye slots.
_frame2: the mask's eye slots blink shut one frame apart.

name: Estafex
_root: open hook - straight shank, one bend, one barb
_silhouette: five hooks fanned from one 18px shank, every barb doubled, a 10px face wearing a second face behind it.
_frame2: the front face slides 2px aside to show the blank face behind, then back.

name: Nulix
flavor_es: No es nada, y ahí está.

_silhouette: 10px circle, one 2px diagonal slash, two dot eyes either side of the slash.

name: Segfalt

_frame2: the four quadrants rotate a quarter turn about the empty centre.

name: Bitto
flavor_es: Un bit feliz: cero o uno.

name: Flipix

name: Podrix
_root: rectangle eroding at the CORNERS (crumble, not slice)
